One sheet per workflow. S = standard SAP operation wrapped · C = composite read · X = multi-stage / no standard end-to-end equivalent.
Version 1.3 · 2026-08-10 · Revised after end-to-end MIGO and order-fulfilment workflow review
Needs source decision — this list may be served by T2/Datasphere rather than SAP.

Needs business decision — portal reconciliation record only, or SAP physical-inventory posting.
• Requests carry only data the caller must choose or assert. SAP derives document, material, quantity, plant and pricing context wherever the referenced document already contains them.
• API-02 and API-06 now model the user’s actual screen inputs: split receipt allocation, selected batches, and shipment details.
• List controls — search, filters, paging and approved sorting — belong only to list/read workflows; not to document commands or cost estimation.
• APIs 11 and 12 close previously unnumbered workflow gaps. API-12 must not be built as a SAP posting until the business decides what Post means.
